            triggered_desc = { trigger = { current_date >= 1361.1.1 } desc = oe_l5.8.desc_y }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { var:oe_l5_ret_n ?= 1 oe_l5_last_way = { w = 1 } } desc = oe_l5.8.desc_ra }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { var:oe_l5_ret_n ?= 1 oe_l5_last_way = { w = 2 } } desc = oe_l5.8.desc_rb }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { var:oe_l5_ret_n ?= 1 oe_l5_last_way = { w = 3 } } desc = oe_l5.8.desc_rc }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { var:oe_l5_ret_n ?= 1 } desc = oe_l5.8.desc_r }

    }

        custom_tooltip = oe_l5.8.a.tt
        hidden_effect = { location:constantinople = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_l5_burned_half years = 2 mode = replace } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_l5_port_shut_half years = 2 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_ret_way value = 1 } }
        ai_chance = { base = 20 modifier = { add = 40 oe_l5_last_way = { w = 1 } } }
    }
    option = {

        custom_tooltip = oe_l5.8.b.tt

# Hidden worker, fired from the options and from .1's immediate (var oe_l5_job): deaths and handovers stay out of the
# option previews. Jobs: 1 Andronikos; 51-53 Didymóteichon; 61-63 Adrianoúpolis.
oe_l5.90 = {
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    title = oe_l5.90.t
    trigger = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
    immediate = {
        if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_job ?= 1 } oe_l5_job_1 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_job ?= 51 } oe_l5_job_51 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_job ?= 52 } oe_l5_job_52 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_job ?= 53 } oe_l5_job_53 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_job ?= 61 } oe_l5_job_61 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_job ?= 62 } oe_l5_job_62 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_job ?= 63 } oe_l5_job_63 = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_job } remove_variable = oe_l5_job }
    }
}
